title: The Ashen Road
description: An expedition on foot through the hot half of the world: a gate
built on the cheap side, a road thrown across the shore of the
lava sea, a fortress whose walls still keep somebody's rules, and
a lantern line that only lights once the bridge behind it is
Mechanically this group is the road's vocabulary: a `dimension`
task, a `location` box with `ignoreDimension` so an example does
not have to pretend it knows your world's coordinates, two
`structure` tasks, one `fluid` task of the molten kind, a slow
`observation` of a block entity, an `advancement` task and an
`advancement` reward, a quest hidden until its prerequisite rule
is met, an experience payout in whole levels, and a hazard-taped
